findings.evidence: Hosts restates which directories Claude Code, opencode, pi, codex and cursor already read for skills, plus an unverified gap note.
findings.fix: Delete the Hosts section; skill discovery is native. Keep only a one-line pointer if the codex non-link is a real operational constraint.

findings.evidence: Tool pattern is right, but the body is a routing stub: request and response shapes, item-writing rules and status actions live only in reference.md.
findings.fix: Keep the probe, consent and NEVER steps in SKILL.md, and add the three item shapes plus the needs_fallback rule inline so the common call does not depend on a second file.

findings.evidence: NEVER covers verdicts, consent, secrets, auto-dismiss and Laya batching, but the gotchas that defy assumptions (whole-state bleed, uncalibrated confidence, empty evidence scoring unsupported at ~99%) sit in reference.md and backends/laya.md.
findings.fix: Add a short Gotchas list to SKILL.md with those three facts and the why, and leave the measured numbers in the backend files.

findings.evidence: reference.md is one file mixing request shape, settings, learning, calibration, hosts and ladder output; SKILL.md says read it before choice, score or receipt with no Do NOT Load split.
findings.fix: Split settings, records and calibration into their own files and gate each read (request shape before a screen call; settings only on needs_answer; records only on record new or changed).

findings.evidence: Consent and ladder are exact, but the common screen call says only 'request shape in reference.md' and 'otherwise the status table', so a wrong item or status is easy to mishandle.
findings.fix: Put the item-key table and the status-to-action rows for ok, disabled, consent_required_for_remote and unavailable in SKILL.md as the default path.

findings.evidence: Eight evals have realistic prompts and verifiable assertions, but casual-flaky-ci asserts 'evidence names the test' while the skill's noul shape uses context, not evidence.
findings.fix: Change that assertion to require context (or criterion/evidence only for shorthand) so the check matches the request shape the skill teaches.

findings.evidence: Ten should-trigger and ten should-not-trigger queries, but most negatives share no judgment keywords, so they barely test the typesafe-ai and code-editing boundary.
findings.fix: Replace four easy negatives with near-misses: a TypeSafe app integration, a code edit that mentions a yes/no choice, a plan review, and a commit that asks which message is better without calling jev.

findings.evidence: Screen calls point at reference.md for the request shape, then say 'otherwise the status table', so an agent can mis-handle disabled, invalid_input or unavailable without opening that file.
findings.fix: Inline the four status actions and one worked noul, choice and score example in SKILL.md, and keep receipts and calibration as gated reads.
